steps.title: Write a press release with Coworker
items: 2 · It writes the release as a Content Fragment in AEM
3 · Check it in the Content Fragment editor

steps.caption: Brief it: model, folder, the facts, and what to write
steps.text: In AEM as a Cloud Service (author-p187853-e1977051), create a Content Fragment with the Press Release model in /content/dam/frescopa/press, named member-week-returns. Headline: "Member Week returns December 3 to 9". Release date: 2026-11-20. Dateline city: Chicago. Image: /content/dam/frescopa/press/images/member-week.jpg, alt text "Illustration: an orange block between grey pillars". Media contact: Frescopa Press Office, press@frescopa.example. Write the summary (one sentence) and the body (three short paragraphs, plain and warm, no hype): Frescopa Circle members get early access, double Velo points and member-only prices for a week; everyone else can join Circle free to take part. Show me the fragment before you create it.

steps.caption: Coworker writes the summary and body, and shows the fragment before it creates anything
The release is a Content Fragment in AEM, in the Frescopa press folder
Open it in the **Content Fragment editor**
Every field of the **Press Release** model, filled in and ready to publish
